# Pinned dependency digests (SHA-256) for the CI workflows.
#
# PDFium assets come from the exact bblanchon/pdfium-binaries release
# chromium/7749 (= PDFium 148.0.7749.0), which cmake/Pdfium.cmake requires.
# Values were read from the GitHub release asset metadata
# (https://api.github.com/repos/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries/releases/tags/chromium%2F7749)
# on 2026-09-13; the workflows download the asset and verify it against this
# file before extracting anything.
#
# Qt 6.11.2 is installed by jurplel/install-qt-action (aqtinstall), which
# verifies each archive against Qt's own published update metadata; there is no
# separately published digest to pin here.
#
